```yaml
name: AMPCode PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - staging
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: pr_review_concurrency
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp

      - name: Run AMPCode analysis
        id: ampcode_analysis
        run: |
          amp analyze --max-files 50 --file-types ts,tsx,js,jsx,py
          echo "::set-output name=comments::$(cat output.json | jq -c '.comments')"

      - name: Post review comments
        if: success()
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          AMPCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/reviews \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"body": "${{ steps.ampcode_analysis.outputs.comments }}"}'
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline that automatically reviews pull requests using the Ampcode AI service when they are opened or updated on the `main` and `staging` branches. It includes steps to check out the code, set up Node.js, install the Ampcode CLI, run the analysis, and post structured review comments directly on the PR. The workflow also handles concurrency and error management to ensure scalability and reliability.
